attributes.whatsNew:
This build restores the Food Log selector to match Workout Log and connects the food composition atlas.

Please test:
1. Time, food selection, amount and Add controls. Search by Chinese/English name or alias and check the icon, reference amount/unit, energy and protein/fat/carbohydrate values.
2. Select a food such as hard-boiled egg, change the amount and save. Verify units, calories, macro totals and daily totals, deletion and duplicate prevention.
3. Upgrade from the previous build and confirm existing food, workout and body-metric records and historical nutrition totals are preserved.
4. Check trend-chart date labels and Settings sharing, About and More Apps.

The bundled offline atlas contains 13,535 complete source records. It does not automatically sync with the Mac database. Quantities and nutrition follow each record's reference unit. Please verify the experience on a real device.
